decisions.observation: DOM mitigates the citation-verification failure mode (verbatim-quote appendices, cite-check flags) that empty guardrails leave unchecked; INV was neutral since both runs recovered from extraction failures equally. Prior rejection was proced

litigation-dispute-resolution/analyze-co.lesson: Invest in record-verification guardrails (verbatim-quote appendices, pin-cites, citation flags) rather than broader analysis, because output quality differentiates on citation integrity, not issue discovery
